description: System "All Items" report graph of a process: Report + one Column and one ReportField per visible column. ReportField.FieldId/ModelId are the only link back to the process schema.
notes: Transcribed from the live GET /metadata/2/{acct}/process/{flow_id}/report/{report_id}/draft read recorded in docs/capabilities/report.all-items.md (dev tenant, 2026-08-17). Ids minted; tenant names replaced with placeholders.
Read-only knowledge: the engine never builds a report (refused at compile, ADR-0004). This shape exists so a reader can recognise the graph, not so a writer can mint one.
The report graph's Column is a DIFFERENT node kind from the process graph's Column (a section holder). Same word, unrelated shapes.
The list record spells the flag IsAllItemsReport; the graph node spells it IsAllItem. Both are real, on two different surfaces — do not 'fix' one to match the other.
Report.Model and ReportField.ModelId both hold the parent PROCESS flow id, not a table model id.
